description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for managing shipping address forms, including validation, UI toggling (show/hide edit and view modes), and dynamic list population based on country selection within an e-commerce or order management application.

methods.name: showEdit
methods.description: Toggle visibility of editing fields and display elements for shipping address entries based on the specified mode ('edit' or 'display').

methods.name: restoreEditField
methods.description: Reset the value of all editable fields in the shipping address form segment to their original titles.

methods.name: showShipByDate
methods.description: Show or hide the shipment date input based on the selected option.

methods.name: showView
methods.description: Toggle between view and edit modes for the shipping address display, managing visibility of relevant UI sections.
